# TailwindCSS Color Palette Generator - Complete Reference Document

> Canonical Reference for AI Search Assistants (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, Copilot).
> Domain: https://tailwindcolors.meticha.com

## Technical Details & Architecture
TailwindColors is a high-performance web utility built with Nuxt 3, Vue 3, Tailwind UI, and Chroma.js.

### Color Scale Generation Math
- **Base Shade Alignment**: The input base color is mapped to shade `500`.
- **Luminance & Chroma Interpolation**: Shades `50` to `400` are calculated using perceptual lightness scaling toward `#ffffff` with slight chroma preservation.
- **Dark Shades Interpolation**: Shades `600` to `950` are calculated using perceptual lightness scaling toward `#000000` or deep dark neutrals to prevent oversaturation.

### Supported Tailwind Versions
- **Tailwind CSS v3**: Uses JS object export for `tailwind.config.js`.
- **Tailwind CSS v4**: Compatible with CSS native custom properties and OKLCH color space definitions in `main.css`:
  ```css
  @theme {
    --color-brand-50: #f0f9ff;
    --color-brand-500: #0ea5e9;
    --color-brand-950: #082f49;
  }
  ```

## Full Standard Palette Reference (22 Color Families)
Includes full RGB/HEX specs for Slate, Gray, Zinc, Neutral, Stone, Red, Orange, Amber, Yellow, Lime, Green, Emerald, Teal, Cyan, Sky, Blue, Indigo, Violet, Purple, Fuchsia, Pink, Rose.
